subject.title: [Bug]: OpenClaw 5.22: ~10 sec per-call inference overhead in infer model run (both --gateway and --local) vs ~1.3 sec direct provider call

question: Should maintainers require a fresh latest-release Hostinger/Docker trace with matched direct and OpenClaw requests before selecting any further performance fix?
rationale: Existing source mitigations plausibly remove contributors, but only current real-environment stage timing can distinguish remaining inference-path work from deployment-specific plugin, startup, or request-shape cost.

options.title: Request current-release trace
options.body: Ask for redacted latest-release local and gateway timings plus stage diagnostics before choosing additional code work.

options.title: Treat as resolved by mitigations
options.body: Close only if maintainers accept that the existing startup changes sufficiently cover the reported production path without fresh Hostinger validation.

recommendation.title: Request current-release trace
recommendation.body: Ask for redacted latest-release local and gateway timings plus stage diagnostics before choosing additional code work.

likelyOwner.reason: The issue is assigned to steipete and the merged provider sweep already performed the closest related live inference investigation.
